annotations.title: A link to the site preview

description: Makes a link that opens the Development site's private preview on any device for 7 days, with no Gemmein sign-in — for showing the app to someone. Anyone holding the link can open the preview until it ends. Each call makes a new link; each is on the founder's Logs. This is what a founder may call a link to show someone, or letting a friend try it.
name: site_share_link
title: A link to the site preview
